claims.claim: Some pension death benefits pass outside probate.
claims.quote: there are certain life insurance policies and pension benefits in the estate
claims.note: Citizens Advice (England) lists certain pension benefits among cases where probate may not be needed.

claims.claim: Life insurance written in trust passes outside probate.
claims.quote: there are certain life insurance policies and pension benefits in the estate
claims.note: The text says certain life insurance policies may not need probate but does not say these are policies written in trust.
